# orders-service

Order records and the partner settlement adapter.

Design notes live in `docs/decisions/`.

## Development

Run the test suite before pushing:

    python3 -m unittest discover -s tests

CI runs the same command on every push and pull request. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`
for house rules on commit structure and keeping design notes in sync.
